items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Red, Red Allen was there all the time and he and Lips used to get together

ctx.x: Who were some of the people you were most friendly with, during this time? People that you really enjoyed seeing up there?

Well. Billie Holiday, she used to come in all the time and sit down and Bird, you know, we were friends. And he'd come in and play. I was always glad to see him. And, of course, Ike Quebec was there all the time and Hot Lips Page, I loved him so. And then Coleman would come by once in a while and Roy (Eldridge) and Red, Red Allen was there all the time and he and Lips used to get together and that was somethin', to hear them jammin', you know. And Budd Johnson used to come by, Joe Thomas, the tenor player,…

Stitts (sic) and Gene Ammons and, you know, practically everybody, you know. There was so many. And Clark Terry and all those guys, you know. It was home. It was like home for the guys, you know. 'Cause I made 'em feel good when they came in there.
